_comment: The seven lineTotals sum to 3325.00, matching the printed total exactly. This case should always reconcile once line entries are extracted at all.

REPLACE THERMOSTAT is 350.00. The OCR renders it '350.¢' with the cents digits lost. Recovering it needs either the reconciliation gap or the pattern of the three identical labour charges above it — both are legitimate, and an extractor that returns null here has behaved correctly and should lose only the price point, not the line.
odometer is genuinely absent from this receipt. null is the correct answer and an extractor that invents one is wrong, not merely imprecise.
